put.summary: Override LIVE API payment acceptance for a business
put.description: The explicit enabled value takes priority over the global default. Only new LIVE payments are affected; existing eligibility checks still apply.

post.summary: Retired: credentials must be generated by the Business owner

post.description: ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Uses the same audience object as push campaigns. Returns immediately; generation runs on a worker.

patch.description: Metadata only. Does not block account, store, or payment activity in this phase.
Independent from account KYC and store verification. Does not introduce eligibility restrictions.

get.summary: List commerce stores for admin review
get.description: Filters combine with AND. creatorEmail matches the owner account contact email case-insensitively and supports partial matches.

get.summary: Get store POS sales totals, payment breakdowns, top products and unpaid clients
get.description: Uses the merchant POS report's accounting and currency conversion. Period: today, last-7-days, last-30-days or all. Dates are inclusive UTC dates and override period.

get.summary: List store POS orders, including pending, paid, partial, credit and canceled sales
get.description: POS channel only. Newest first. Size 1–100. Amounts retain their recorded currencies; no order access tokens or fulfillment/download links are returned. Dates are inclusive UTC dates.

get.summary: List and search a store's registered clients
get.description: Store CRM contacts across all sales channels; anonymous walk-in buyers are on the orders instead. Search matches name, email or phone. Newest first, page size 1–100. Use customerId on the POS orders endpoint to inspect a client's POS history.

get.summary: List commerce products for admin review
Fetch the current Bridgecard issuing wallet balance
List businesses
get.description: Email is a case-insensitive literal substring of the owner account email. Filters combine with AND.

get.summary: Get a business and its owner account identity
Browse Business Tools customers
get.description: One row per account. Defaults to verified paid Business Tools purchases; use payment=ANY for grant, legacy-only or pending customers. This is a directory, not the effective-access policy.

get.summary: Customer plans, payment summary and current effective access
Browse the global Business Tools purchase ledger
get.description: One row per purchase, including pending, failed, cancelled and refunded attempts. Paid amounts retain their own currency.

get.summary: View one Business Tools purchase and its payment transaction
List sandbox Business API payments across businesses
get.description: Read-only SANDBOX history. Filters combine with AND. accountId is the Business owner; date bounds are inclusive Unix milliseconds. Never returns LIVE transactions or credential secrets.

get.summary: Inspect a sandbox API payment by its Fondeka reference
get.description: Uses the opaque fondekaReference from the sandbox payment. No simulation, settlement, provider call or webhook is triggered by this read.

get.summary: Poll a contact export and retrieve its temporary download link
List available CSV fields and the default selection

delete.summary: Delete a finished push campaign from the admin list
delete.description: Requires ACCOUNT or ANONYMOUS campaignType from the list. Returns 409 while enqueuing or while jobs are pending/processing. Preserves delivery jobs and deduplication history; repeated deletion returns 204.

environment.description: Determined by the API key, not the URL.

fondekaReference.description: Opaque Fondeka payment reference used for polling. Preserve exactly; do not infer environment from its format.

amount.description: Net fiat amount after fees. For a completed collection this is the reconciled wallet credit; before completion it is the quote.

fee.description: One consolidated fiat fee, including all fee components. grossAmount = amount + fee.

grossAmount.description: Gross fiat amount including fee; payout wallet debit. Completed collections show reconciled gross.

currency.description: Fiat denomination for amount, grossAmount and fee.

status.description: ACCEPTED means queued for execution. PROCESSING means execution has started or the outcome is unresolved. COMPLETED and FAILED are terminal; cancellation/expiry are FAILED. Poll ACCEPTED and PROCESSING with the original reference.

failureCode.description: Optional sanitized payment failure code. Not an HTTP request error; do not branch on translated messages.

failureMessage.description: Optional displayable failure message; not guaranteed for every provider/outcome.

BusinessApiTransactionResource.description: Payment state. Money fields are fiat values in currency; completed collections show settled amounts. HTTP acceptance is not financial completion.

providerName.description: Collection wallet configuration currently supports BITCART only.

version.description: Required on PUT; use the latest saved version.

code.description: Uppercase two-letter country code for flags
